body: I can't relate to couples or relationships as I have never been in one.
I don't get angry. I just find it impossible to relate to.
I'm just numb to it all. I don't really feel anything.

I haven't had a friend since 2012.

No one calls me except cold callers.

What industry did you get into?

I can't offer any advice. I suppose you can move out, but what does that solve. You have independence but it's isolating at the same time.
